# Casher

> Casher helps UK freelancers and individuals spot and cancel unused subscriptions by analyzing CSV bank statements. No bank login required.

Casher is a web app. Users upload bank transaction data in CSV files and get categorized spending and possible recurring payments to review. Casher does not collect bank passwords, PINs or security codes. Free and Pro (£9.99/month) are available; Premium, optional Open Banking connections and native mobile apps are in development. Stripe collects payment details separately on hosted checkout; paying for Pro does not connect a bank. Casher does not cancel provider contracts automatically.
